# Hosea Chapter 4 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folio 331r | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/HOS_004_page_001.jpg

---

**4:1** Hear the-word of-YHWH, O-sons of-Yisra'el, for YHWH has-a-case [riv] with-the-inhabitants of-the-land; for there-is-no truth [emet] and-no loyalty [chesed] and-no knowledge [da'at] of-God in-the-land.

**4:2** Swearing [aloh] and-lying [vekhachesh] and-killing [veratsoch] and-stealing [veganev] and-committing-adultery [vena'of] — they-break-out [paratsu], and-blood [damim] touches [nag'u] blood.

**4:6** My-people are-destroyed [nidmu] for-lack [mi-beli] of-knowledge [ha-da'at]; because you have-rejected [ma'asta] knowledge, I-will-reject-you [em'askha] from-being-priest [mi-kahen] for-me; and-you-have-forgotten [vatishkach] the-torah of-your-God [elohekha] — I-will-forget [eshkach] your-children [banekha] also [gam ani].

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.1 — The divine lawsuit:** *Riv* — a legal term for a covenant lawsuit. YHWH brings a formal case against Israel. The charges: no *emet* (truth/reliability), no *chesed* (covenant loyalty), no *da'at elohim* (knowledge of God).

**v.6 — "destroyed for lack of knowledge":** *Da'at* here is not intellectual knowledge but relational knowing — intimacy with God expressed through covenant faithfulness. The priests failed to teach it; the people perish without it.

*— EMET*
